name: Ghostlands: a ghost released in the Amani Catacombs reaches a Spirit Healer (#7648)
contract: A player who dies inside the Amani Catacombs (zone 10127, at the Mummified Headhunter spawn (7597.8,-7261,155.5)) releases at the nearest graveyard of Ghostlands (3433), graveyard 915 (7694.18,-6730.11,48.2907), instead of the default Westfall graveyard. Its Spirit Healer 6491 stands near it. Death and spirit release use the native handlers.

steps.label: The released player is a ghost
The ghost lands at the Ghostlands graveyard
A Spirit Healer stands at the ghost's graveyard
